item.title: Political divide threatens Kurdish autonomy; US urges unity
item.description: Editor's note: this story was translated from the original VOA Kurdish article. Last week's withdrawal of the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan from the Iraqi Kurdistan’s regional government has deepened the political standoff between the region's two main ruling parties. The rise in tensions came after a disputed parliamentary session prompted the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK) to announce its withdrawal from the Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG). item.title: Ukraine looks to international partners to cover growing financing needs
item.description: Editor's note: this story was translated from the original VOA Ukrainian article. item.title: US-based Russian activist sentenced to 6 years in absentia for "military fakes"
item.description:
Editor's note: this story was translated from the original VOA Russian article. A court in Ulan-Ude, Russia, has sentenced U.S.-based activist and researcher Maria Vyushkova in absentia to six years in prison on a charge of allegedly “spreading knowingly false information” about the Russian armed forces.
